raw.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS denominator, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.run_id ILIKE '%896%') AS resolution_896_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.p50_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.p90_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.p99_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.max_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431) AS measured_36_421_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.p50_ms BETWEEN 31.9725 AND 31.9735 OR p.p90_ms BETWEEN 31.9725 AND 31.9735 OR p.p99_ms BETWEEN 31.9725 AND 31.9735 OR p.max_ms BETWEEN 31.9725 AND 31.9735) AS predicted_31_973_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.run_id ILIKE '%896%' AND (p.p50_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.p90_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.p99_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431 OR p.max_ms BETWEEN 36.411 AND 36.431)) AS joint_rows, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('run_id',p.run_id,'window',p.window_name,'p50_ms',p.p50_ms,'p90_ms',p.p90_ms,'p99_ms',p.p99_ms,'max_ms',p.max_ms,'n_requests',p.n_requests) ORDER BY p.run_id) FILTER (WHERE p.run_id ILIKE '%896%') AS resolution_896_breakdown FROM provenance.v_pool_latency p JOIN provenance.v_dim d USING (run_id) WHERE p.is_current=true AND d.is_current=true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL
raw.evidence: Across all 2,217 current, non-superseded pool-latency rows—including 32 u896 rows spanning burst3, burst4, burst5, and steady24h—neither 36.421 ms nor 31.973 ms appears in any latency field, and v_pool_latency has no predicted-latency or patch-count field supporting the claimed ratio.
